title: Squeal Ladder
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A screaming 303-style acid lead built on a sawtooth driven through a resonant ladder filter with a fast lpenv squelch on every note. Over 16 cycles the resonance and filter-envelope depth climb while a slow LFO drags the cutoff up and a stepped ply gate chops the rhythm tighter, so the loop morphs from a round acid burble into a full-throated roar.
code:
setcpm(130/4)
stack(
  note("<c2 c2 eb2 g2 c2 bb1 ab1 g2>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .ply("<1 1 2 1 2 4>/8")
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(420, 3200))
    .resonance(saw.slow(16).range(14, 22)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(saw.slow(16).range(2.5, 6)).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay("<0.09 0.14 0.05>/4")
    .penv("<0 0 7 -5>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.06)
    .distort(sine.slow(32).range(0.6, 1.6))
    .shape(0.4)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.16).sustain(0.55).release(0.05)
    .off(0.005, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.3))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .delay("0.3:0.1875:0.45").room(0.18)
    .gain(0.9)
)
